purpose: Observe whether an actual GitHub-signed OIDC job claim correlates with current run, job and main metadata.
allowed_output: fixed names of failed local precondition checks

interpretation.IDENTITY_CORRELATION_OBSERVED: One GitHub-hosted job had matching signed job/run claims and metadata at observation time. This is not an independent credential boundary or proof of replay, cost, writer coverage, Worker runtime, D1 or PAPER readiness.
interpretation.otherwise: No activation; preserve failure and do not rerun.
